title: Using the Biomate 5 Spectrophotometer
author: Dr. Steven Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iktccwn

steps.title: Warm up spectrophotometer
steps.instruction: Turn on the Biomate 5 Spectrophotometer and allow it to warm up for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Select test name
steps.instruction: Use the arrow keys on the home menu to highlight the desired test name (e.g., dsDNA+, scan noise) and press enter.

steps.title: Load samples
steps.instruction: Load the blank into position 1 and place the remaining samples into the other cells.

steps.title: Run samples
steps.instruction: Confirm that you are running the samples when prompted by the program.

steps.title: Measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Allow the program to automatically set the baseline absorbance using the blank and report the absorbance for each sample.

steps.title: Record results
steps.instruction: Take a picture of the absorbance profiles.
